verdict.rationale: WooCommerce ships an official, first-party CLI (WC-CLI) for managing stores from the command line, documented in the core repo and in a dedicated developer docs category confirmed by probe. The evidence establishes the CLI exists but says little about how much it covers or how well it suits agents. Missing for 10: detail on command coverage and machine-readable output for AI-agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
